CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 11 / 12

Graphs and evidence

Axes, slope and shifts座標、斜率與移動

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Read axes, coordinates, intercepts and slope (Δy/Δx), including negative, zero and vertical slopes; distinguish a movement along a curve from a shift.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先辨認橫縱軸及單位。斜率是縱向變化除橫向變化；水平為零，垂直斜率未定義。軸上的變數改變與整條關係移動須分清。

Read the axis labels before interpreting a graph. Slope is Δy/Δx; horizontal lines have zero slope and vertical slopes are undefined. A changed variable on an axis usually moves a point along a fixed relationship; another determinant can shift it.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：From (Q=2,P=8) to (Q=6,P=4), slope=(4−8)/(6−2)=−1 dollars per unit. 斜率為每單位數量負一元。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

From (x=1,y=7) to (x=4,y=1), slope? 斜率多少？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
